subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): onModelDiagnosticEvent for trusted model.* events

question: Should OpenClaw expose model usage to arbitrary plugins through a generic diagnostic subscription, or reserve it for a typed, provider-owned/explicitly enabled usage API?
rationale: Both paths define long-lived Plugin SDK and telemetry-access contracts with different ownership, enablement, and provenance semantics; source review cannot safely choose that product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt a typed usage contract
options.body: Replace or narrow this diagnostic subscription to a provider-owned, explicitly enabled model-usage interface with defined ownership and payload guarantees.

options.title: Approve the diagnostic subscription
options.body: Keep this API, explicitly accepting generic plugin access to the allowlisted non-integrity model telemetry and documenting its intended observability-only use.

options.title: Defer public exposure
options.body: Keep trusted model diagnostics internal until a broader telemetry API direction is sponsored and designed.

recommendation.title: Adopt a typed usage contract
recommendation.body: Replace or narrow this diagnostic subscription to a provider-owned, explicitly enabled model-usage interface with defined ownership and payload guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: The related provider-scoped usage contract makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for the API-boundary decision.
